The letter 'Re' sits in its right part (outside the kite ellipse), with the word 'Rectangle' printed at the bottom-right and a long arrow from it pointing up-left to 'Re'. The letter 'S' sits in the part of the rectangle ellipse that lies inside the kite ellipse (the left end of the bold ellipse, within the overlap), with the word 'Square' printed above the top of the ellipses and an arrow pointing down to the S. So: kite and parallelogram overlap = rhombus; the part of the rectangle ellipse inside the rhombus lens = square; rectangle ellipse inside the parallelogram ellipse.
